review:
Spider Circus Hold and Win brings hold-and-win mechanics to an eerie, Burton-style fairground on 60 lines. Six or more spiders trigger the Hold & Win bonus, with multipliers and prizes inside.

A meter shows the number of bonus symbols collected. Chance x2 slightly raises the bet to double the chance of scatters and the bonus. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. It's similar to Royal Beellion, with a spooky circus theme that works year-round.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
